seo.title: Volunteer With Us | EireTech360 Ireland
seo.description: Join EireTech360 Ireland as a volunteer and help make digital knowledge, creativity and opportunity more welcoming in the community.

hero.title: Share your skills. [g]Create momentum.[/g]
hero.subtitle: We warmly welcome people who want to share their skills, curiosity and energy with the EireTech360 Ireland chapter.

image.alt: A mosaic of community-minded volunteers in a creative workspace

ireland.label: Ireland vision
ireland.title: A more open digital future is built together.
ireland.body: Useful digital knowledge, creativity and opportunity should feel welcoming—not out of reach.

introduction.label: A genuine welcome
introduction.title: Bring what you know. Help someone move forward.
introduction.body: Whether your experience is in technology, design, marketing, storytelling or community support, your contribution can make a shared initiative more useful and human.
highlights: A respectful space for practical skills and different perspectives.
A contribution shaped around your interests and availability.
A shared focus on making digital opportunity more accessible.

opportunities.label: Ways to contribute
opportunities.title: Small contributions can create real momentum.
opportunities.body: Start with the skills you already have and we can discuss a useful, realistic way to get involved.

items.title: Community support
items.text: Help create a friendly, inclusive experience for people taking early steps into digital topics.

items.title: Storytelling & creative work
items.text: Use writing, design, photography or content skills to make useful ideas clearer and more welcoming.

items.title: Digital skills sharing
items.text: Share a practical tool, tip or way of thinking that can help someone feel more confident online.

companion.label: Careers & internships
companion.title: Looking for an early-career learning path instead?
companion.body: Discover internships and development-focused opportunities with EireTech360 Ireland.

cta.label: We would love to meet you
cta.title: Your welcome starts with a simple introduction.
cta.body: Tell us how you would like to contribute and we will be pleased to begin the conversation.
